name: Heber
overview: Heber was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Mered and his Jewish wife. His lineage is noted in 1 Chronicles 4:18, highlighting his place within the genealogical records of Israel. No additional personal notes are recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Heber means 'associate' and is a proper name mentioned in 1 Chronicles 4:18. There is no indication that this name was given by God, but it reflects a common Hebrew personal name without additional titles or meanings.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Heber as the son of Mered and the grandson of Soco, establishing a clear paternal line in 1 Chronicles 4:18. No other family relationships are documented beyond these.
scriptureSignificance: Heber's significance lies in his inclusion in the genealogical lineage of Judah, as preserved in the Old Testament. His identification as the son of Mered and a Jewish wife underscores the continuity of the tribe of Judah during the post-exilic period. While not highlighted for specific deeds, Heber represents a link in the faithful preservation of Israel's tribal heritage.
